subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: the teacher said to the girl do you think that honesty is the best policy yes sir i think so said the girl then learn to be honest from your childhood thank you sir said the girl may allah bless you said the teacher Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Follow my example," she said as we shook hands, "and never eat more than one thing for luncheon." "I'll do better than that," I retorted. "I'll eat nothing for dinner tonight." "Humorist," she cried gaily jumping into a cab. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 208
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Ispahani Public School & College, Cumilla (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
